source_terms: Research purposes only; not for commercial use. Do not redistribute source images in runner releases.
reviewer: Codex visual review; one model reviewer, no independent human adjudication
status: All 200 evaluation pages and all four duplicate candidates visually reviewed; five category judgments remain uncertain.

method.contact_sheet_format: 21 category-specific JPEG sheets, 4 columns x 3 rows, 450 x 680 pixel labeled cells; page aspect ratio preserved.
method.full_page_followup: Individual canonical PNG views for ambiguous degradation, handwriting and column labels and for each duplicate candidate. Tool display may scale the page; native-pixel examination and transcription were not performed.
method.label_basis: The observed feature, not the metadata label alone, determines the verdict. Supported means visible presence, not a minimum severity or dominance threshold. Categories can overlap.

verdict_definitions.supported: The declared feature is visually present, with any mild or incidental presence described in evidence.
verdict_definitions.uncertain: The declared feature is not established by the inspected image, or its meaning depends on a broader taxonomy than sustained text columns/genuine handwriting/visible degradation.
verdict_definitions.mixed_content: The broad single-column ordinary selector is satisfied, but tables, formulas, code, screenshots or infographics prevent treating the page as a clean plain-prose baseline.

limitations: One visual reviewer; no inter-rater agreement estimate.
Contact sheets establish page layout/content presence, not recognition accuracy or measured blur, contrast or font size.
Only three calibration pages were inspected as duplicate-pair counterparts; the 64-page calibration set has not received a complete visual audit.
Four coarse perceptual-hash candidates are not an exhaustive proof of cross-split independence; variants can evade this hash.
Source filename family IDs do not reliably identify writers, publication series or original documents when filenames are opaque.

summary.ordinary_supported_caveat: Only seven ordinary pages have supported labels; these include a sparse cover (E185) and a diagram/list page (E172). Five have an observed plain_prose tag: E179, E180, E189, E192 and E195. Do not describe all 35 as plain paragraphs.
summary.handwriting_diversity_caveat: 22 of 25 evaluation pages come from two identifiable notebooks. All eight calibration handwriting pages come from a third notebook. These are page counts, not 33 independent writers; writer identity is not established.
summary.table_and_formula_caveat: All selected table/formula pages visibly contain the feature, but some feature regions are small or incidental. E105 has only a short table fragment below equations; E069 contains elementary fractions. Presence does not establish difficult table structure or formula complexity.
summary.tiny_text_caveat: Fine type is visually present relative to page size. The frozen metadata rule is at least 1000 annotated text characters and median line height at most 0.012 of page height; no calibrated glyph-size measurement was performed visually.

planned_domain_coverage.evidence: Five ordinary pages have an observed plain_prose tag; most ordinary pages contain tables/formulas/code or other mixed material.
None of the 200 inspected evaluation pages is an identifiable retail/payment receipt.
Sparse dividers/covers exist, but no fully blank page was observed. The selector rejects pages without text, LaTeX or HTML annotations.
Sparse title/divider, cover and exercise pages are recorded in the per-page tags.
E099 contains a sideways table. Mild skew/warping occurs in degraded scans. No entire page rotated 90 or 180 degrees was observed.

Pinned evaluation annotations contain 97 English, 87 simplified Chinese and 16 English/Chinese mixed pages. Incidental foreign words in interface screenshots do not establish broader language coverage. Arabic, Indic, Cyrillic, Hebrew and other script families are not represented by reviewed page-level samples.
Visible bleed-through, soft scans, watermarks, page warping and low contrast occur. E013 remains uncertain, and several others have only mild degradation.
Newspapers, indices and scientific pages have dense text. Generated token lengths, completeness and long-output accuracy require separate inference and reference checks.

newspaper_hash_family_cross_split_check.limitation: No same hash-prefix family spans splits, but distinct hash prefixes can still be the same publication, as Federal Register demonstrates.

candidates.visual_evidence: Left is the 70th Putnam competition solutions dated December 5, 2009, beginning with a square/functional-equation solution. Right is the 72nd competition problems dated December 3, 2011, beginning with growing spirals. Their text, mathematics and block locations differ; the two-column serif competition template is shared.
candidates.independence_caveat: Different competition years and different content do not establish independent document style. Group the Putnam archive conservatively for calibration/evaluation style independence, or explicitly report this shared family.

candidates.independence_caveat: This pair is not a visual duplicate; the review does not prove independence from every other corpus page.

candidates.visual_evidence: Left is Grzimek's Animal Life Encyclopedia cumulative index, page 51, with alphabetic animal entries. Right is Federal Register volume 89, number 134, July 12, 2024, page 57162, with Bureau of Land Management notices. Both have three narrow columns, but the headers and content are different.
candidates.independence_caveat: The coarse layout hash is a false positive for page duplication. The calibration page shares a publication template with another evaluation candidate below.

candidates.visual_evidence: Left is Federal Register volume 78, number 151, August 6, 2013, page 47671, with Commerce/insurance-survey notices. Right is volume 89, number 134, July 12, 2024, page 57162, with Interior/public-land-sale notices. Dates, page numbers, departments and body text differ, while the three-column Federal Register template is shared.
candidates.independence_caveat: This is a shared publication/style family across splits despite different opaque filename hashes. It should not be called a duplicate page, but it weakens a claim of source-family independence.

duplicate_review.conclusion: All four candidates are visibly different pages. This rejects those same-page duplicate hypotheses but does not prove source/style independence across the full corpus.

followup_provenance_audit.finding: Generic _page_N filename suffixes were not normalized by the v2 selector. Three identifiable original documents actually span evaluation/calibration despite no exact image/text duplicates.
followup_provenance_audit.method: Apply case-insensitive ^(.*)_page_[0-9]+\.[^.]+$ to all 264 pinned source image names and compare split membership of each stem.

followup_provenance_audit.disposition: V2 must not be used for a family-independent calibration/evaluation claim. Correct these original-document splits in v3, in addition to the broader shared-publication considerations. Frozen v2 locks remain unchanged.

recommended_disposition.frozen_v2: Keep all frozen files unchanged. V2 is useful for diagnostic CPU/GPU parity and descriptive OCR evaluation when results carry reviewed tags. Keep uncertain labels separate and report ordinary as mixed single-column documents. Do not use this review as acceptance of full planned-domain coverage or calibration/source-family independence.
recommended_disposition.before_calibration_tuning: Resolve the desired family boundary, group shared publication/competition templates conservatively, and visually audit the full calibration set. Do not infer independence from zero exact hashes or distinct opaque IDs.
recommended_disposition.before_representative_full_evaluation_cl: Freeze a separately named v3 selection with explicit category definitions, missing-domain samples and reviewed family overrides. Selection must depend on metadata and visual evidence, not model output quality.
v3_reproducible_remedy: Create a versioned category-policy JSON and a visual-overrides JSON keyed by pinned dataset revision plus source image SHA256. Include explicit include/exclude decisions, reason and canonical parent/publication family; hash both into the v3 manifest.

Rename the broad existing ordinary category to mixed_single_column, or select a true plain_prose cohort. Proposed deterministic prefilter: same four source types, single_column, at least 500 annotated text characters across nonignored blocks, and no nonignored table, table_mask, equation_isolated, code_txt or algorithm_mask. Then visually reject image-dominant pages, symbol-heavy inline mathematics, sparse covers and annotation misses.

The proposed strict plain-prose prefilter has 43 candidates in the pinned full annotation file, before split reservations and visual review; 31 are not selected in v2. It therefore cannot automatically supply 35 evaluation plus 16 calibration pages under that policy. Either reduce those quotas explicitly, expand reviewed source types, or add a separately pinned permitted source; never silently relax the criteria to fill quotas.

Define multi_column as at least two sustained text columns; treat contents-page number gutters and image/title panels separately. Override E143, E157 and E158 as ambiguous layout samples rather than confident multi-column pages. Replace E013 and E030 in confident degraded/handwriting strata unless an independent reviewer resolves them.

Extend family normalization to notes/hash-page, newspaper/hash-page and PDF/page patterns. Add explicit publication/template overrides for Putnam and Federal Register where conservative style-independent splits are required. Select families before pages and reserve calibration families first; report unresolved opaque provenance.

Use a new fixed ranking seed such as falcon-cpu-corpus-v3 with the same deterministic SHA256 rank over split/category/source ID after applying the versioned policy and overrides. Rebuild all v3 locks and repeat exact, text and perceptual duplicate checks followed by visual candidate review.

Add explicit receipts, blank pages, full-page rotation and additional scripts from pinned, permitted sources. If blank/rotation tests are synthetic, record transform parameters and parent SHA256, keep derivatives with their parent split and report them separately from natural scans. Retain independent natural receipts/languages for coverage claims.

Record family and notebook counts alongside page counts, and provide per-stratum results. Dense appearance alone does not qualify long-output support: validate output length/completeness separately against the pinned GPU model.
